descriptionHtml:
Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5 16GB (1 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Module (Dynamic Ten-Zone RGB Light Bar / Dual Profile AMD EXPO & Intel XMP 3.0 Compatible / Single Stick UDIMM / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Upgrade your system performance and aesthetic layout with the Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5 16GB (1x16GB) 6000MHz Single Memory Stick in sleek black finish, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Delivering top-tier speed up to 6000MHz with tight CL38 timings at 1.35V, this single DDR5 UDIMM module is ideal for new gaming builds or expanding existing RAM capacity. Equipped with a dynamic ten-zone RGB light bar housed in a solid aluminum heatspreader, it provides fully customizable illumination synchronized across your rig using Corsair iCUE software. With pre-configured dual profile hardware support for both AMD EXPO and Intel XMP 3.0, it allows seamless one-click BIOS overclocking optimization across modern desktop motherboards.
